sourcePlan.title: KERN bent arrival & separate stairs

L0.name: Compact court & operations
L0.note: The east entrance immediately bends south and west. Freight is near arrival; Operations can only be reached around the south and west sides of the courtyard, with multiple turns. Reception has no Operations door. The separate northwest main stair is reached through Archive / reading. There is no west-side pedestrian entrance.

L1.name: Small crew quarters & overlook
L1.note: The main stair arrives in the northwest quiet wing. Bedrooms and the Operations overlook branch from the west hall; one kitchen / common room leads to the southeast freight landing and terrace. The main stair and freight shaft are separate, vertically aligned cores.

B1.name: Research & lower expedition bay
B1.note: The northwest main stair reaches Decode through a continuous bent research approach. The southeast freight shaft remains next to clean equipment transfer. Garage / workshop / dirty rooms remain at −5.70 m; eight 0.15 m risers lead to the clean landing at −4.50 m, then the separate clean transfer stair returns to L0.

B2.name: Stabilization & cave routes
B2.note: The northwest main stair enters the west stabilization gallery; freight still enters from the southeast service link. Cave routes and all six stabilization nodes are retained. Only volumes below the lower garage/decon bay use reduced clear height.

designReferences: Säynätsalo: protected outdoor court and differentiated thresholds
Rostlaube: clustered choices and short loops
Carpenter Center: multiple approaches and interlocking volumes
Yale A&A: sectional hierarchy and overlook
designSequence: East entry → open south turn → open west elbow → arrival return → nearby freight
Arrival return → core junction → south court passage → west turn → west hall → north return → Operations
West hall → Archive / reading → separate northwest main stair
Lower garage → dirty gear → wash → eight-step rise → clean equipment transfer → southeast freight

approaches.note: 35 m separate west approach; 5.7 m descent. Gameplay slope, not vehicle-code certification.

notes: Operations has only its west doorway
No pedestrian external door on the west face
Main stair and freight centers are 30 m apart
routeStudy.measurement: Indicative safe orthogonal centerline walks from the main east threshold to the destination threshold; not shortest-distance optimization.
